integrity: The structural theorem follows from divisor support, the decimal digit-sum congruence modulo 9, an explicit finite exceptional check, and a monotone digit-length bound. The density conclusion uses standard prime-counting, Mertens, and Landau estimates. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the layer Omega(n)=2 and gives an upper bound, not an asymptotic, for the number of semiprime Moran numbers. The original 1993 problem and the full 2013 chain paper were not available for complete inspection.
title: Least-prime rigidity and zero semiprime density for Moran numbers
